title: Press every button on the Siri Remote
persona: Someone who has picked up the Apple TV remote and presses every button to see what happens, sometimes twice in a row.
goal: Move around the channels with the arrows, select things, press Menu (back), play/pause, and Home, from the player and from every channel. Come back into the app whenever a button takes you out.
success: every button was pressed somewhere, and the app is still playing
